items.title: 3 Tech Stocks Boosting Buyback Capacity in the Face of the Sector's Recent Tumble

items.title: JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF (JGLO) Adds Microsoft and NXP on Oct. 29
items.summary: The fund bought $18.9 million of Microsoft and $6.6 million of NXP Semiconductors while selling $22.0 million of Alphabet and $21.0 million of Apple.
